color.gray.black: Focus rings only (2px solid outline, 1px outside the element) and where a spec names it; otherwise use gray-min for black. Text on a color chip falls back to it when neither gray-min nor gray-max passes 4.5:1.
color.gray.min: Black text, icons and elements: headlines, body copy and labels on gray-max, gray-600, gray-500 and neutral-panel (18.4:1 on gray-max, 16.0:1 on gray-600).
color.gray.100: Secondary text: excerpts, tooltip text, section titles (11.6:1 on gray-max).
color.gray.200: Meta text: timestamps and captions (6.6:1 on gray-max, 5.7:1 on gray-600; the lightest gray that passes AA for small text on white).
color.gray.300: Borders that must read as a boundary: the Tooltip box and caret edge, the ModalsCenter card. Not for small text (3.8:1 on gray-max).
color.gray.400: Masthead rules (Masthead and ObitMastHead, 1px). Not for text (2.4:1 on gray-max).
color.gray.500: 1px card borders and dividers (Blocks, article cards, modal rules); the documentation sample stage. Not for text (1.6:1 on gray-max).
color.gray.600: Panel fill: InLineMessage panels. Text on it uses gray-min (16.0:1).
color.gray.max: White: page and card backgrounds; text on theme-primary fills (Button Primary label).
color.feedback.low-success: Low-priority / success alerts (InLineMessage). 5.0:1 on gray-max; 4.35:1 on gray-600 fails AA for small text.
color.feedback.medium: Medium-priority alerts. 5.2:1 on gray-max, 4.5:1 on gray-600.
color.feedback.high-error: High-priority alerts and errors. 5.3:1 on gray-max, 4.6:1 on gray-600.
color.neutral.panel: Neutral panel fill from the Colors collection.
color.surface.nav-panel: Navigation panel surface from the Colors collection.
color.tributes.primary-lighter: Endless Tributes (obituaries) ramp: lighter step. Obituaries look the same on every site, whatever the theme.
color.tributes.tan-light: Endless Tributes (obituaries) light tan; replaced the off-palette beige #ccc7bc (Karl, 2026-10-19).
color.theme.primary-light: Theme primary ramp, light step: Button Primary hover and pressed fill.
color.theme.primary: The theme's brand color: Button Primary fill, links, kickers, active tab, card hover border and headline, eyebrow underline.
color.theme.primary-dark: Theme primary ramp, dark step: Button Primary border.
color.theme.secondary: Theme secondary accent. Fills only, never text on white.
color.theme.tertiary: Theme tertiary accent. Fills only, never text on white.
color.theme.near-black: Theme neutral near-black: nav labels and UI text.
color.theme.white: Theme neutral white: backgrounds and inverse text.
color.theme.nav-text: Navigation text and labels; equals near-black in every theme.
radius.utility: 5px. Containers only: InLineMessage, modals, form fields, check boxes, status badge, account dropdown. Never buttons.
shadow.lg: Anything floating: modals, bottom panels, dropdowns, menus, tooltips.
